name: Higgsfield
summary: Image and video generation (SOUL, Kling, Seedance, Wan and more) through one asynchronous request API.

key_id.description: The key ID of a Higgsfield API credential (console.higgsfield.ai).

key_secret.description: The secret of the same Higgsfield API credential.

notes: Each model has its own endpoint path (its endpoint ID) and JSON body; the console (console.higgsfield.ai) and docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models list them. Only a few are named here.

Generation is asynchronous: a submission returns {status: queued, request_id, status_url, cancel_url}; poll higgsfield.requests.status every 2 s backing off to 10 s until completed, failed, nsfw or canceled.
Charged to the account balance only on success; failed, nsfw and canceled requests are refunded. Estimate a cost first with POST /estimate/{endpoint id} and the same body.
Over the concurrency limit, requests queue; when the queue is full a submission gets 429 with Retry-After. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retried submission does not create a duplicate.
Output files are kept seven days after the request finishes (expires_at in the status answer); download what you keep.

endpoints.name: Generate images with SOUL V2
endpoints.summary: Submits a text-to-image request (portraits, fashion, editorial); returns a request id to poll.

prompt.example: A ceramic vase on a wooden table beside a sunlit window, editorial photograph.

style_id.description: UUID of a SOUL style; a default general style is used when omitted.

custom_reference_id.description: UUID of a completed Soul ID character reference owned by the account.

custom_reference_strength.description: Above 0 and up to 1 when custom_reference_id is set; default 1.

seed.description: 1 to 1000000; random when omitted (null is invalid).

idempotency_key.description: Makes a retried submission return the original request instead of a duplicate.

notes: A read over POST charged to the balance on success.

endpoints.name: Estimate a SOUL V2 image request
endpoints.summary: Cost in USD for a SOUL V2 request with the given body, without generating.

prompt.description: The same body you would submit for generation.

notes: A read over POST; free. Returns {usd}. Any model can be estimated at /estimate/{its endpoint ID}.

endpoints.name: Generate a video with Kling 3.0 Pro
endpoints.summary: Submits a text-to-video request with optional native audio and multi-shot prompts; returns a request id to poll.

prompt.description: What the video shows, up to 2,500 characters; required even with multi_prompt.

multi_shots.description: true to use multi_prompt custom shots.

multi_prompt.description: 1 to 6 shots of {prompt (up to 512 chars), duration (1-15 s)}; their durations are summed for billing.

idempotency_key.description: Makes a retried submission return the original request.

notes: A read over POST charged to the balance on success.

endpoints.name: Get request status and output
endpoints.summary: State (queued, in_progress, completed, failed, nsfw, canceled) and output URLs when completed.

endpoints.name: Cancel a queued request
endpoints.summary: Cancels a request that has not started; it is refunded.
notes: 202 with an empty body on success; 400 once processing has started.

endpoints.name: Delete a finished request's data
endpoints.summary: Deletes a finished request's files, prompt and parameters now; billing records stay.
notes: Fails while the request is still queued or in progress.
